cohort: All64 existing development contexts, IDs0..31 per task, all6blocks and all3conditions
primary_metric: Within-context log(cubic center MSE / linear center MSE), defined only when both errors are positive
contrasts: FP32 field BF16 roundtrip minus FP32
actual BF16 predictor minus FP32 field BF16 roundtrip
zero_policy: Explicit both_zero, linear_zero, cubic_zero counts. No epsilon. A mean/CI requiring an undefined context is itself undefined; no selective complete-case summary.
resampling: 32 whole contexts with replacement within task; identical weights across all layers, conditions and contrasts
intervals: Marginal paired-scenario percentile95; max absolute standardized bootstrap deviation for simultaneous95 across the six layers of each task/condition-pair contrast. Separate contrast families, not an all-task/global discovery claim.
audit: Report/DONE/STARTED and cloud download-SHA bindings before aggregation; all18 metric cells per context. Independently recompute Gram reconstruction, donor RMS, and finite-difference RMS identities. Direct tensor errors and exact byte/RNG parity remain execution-attested; bulk fields were not retained.
limitations: Predictor/unroll autocast with shared FP32 encoding, not single-kernel precision or physical-coordinate causality. Symmetric center interpolation is quadratic-compatible. No planner/control outcomes or new protected confirmation. All layers retained, no winner. Marginal intervals are descriptive.
